tools.name: law.search
tools.description: Searches US federal, state, and municipal law by topic or keyword (legality, permits, zoning, licensing, compliance, filing requirements). Returns ranked provisions with verbatim citations, headings, snippets, and node ids. `jurisdiction` limits results to one state, federal law, or a city.

tools.name: law.get_node
tools.description: Returns the full official text, citation, and hierarchy of one legal provision, by its node id (the UUID in search results).

tools.name: law.list_coverage
tools.description: Lists the covered jurisdictions (federal, state, and municipal) with per-jurisdiction provision counts, searchable-chunk counts, GIS status, and a placeholder flag.

tools.name: account.status
tools.description: Reports the credit balance, tier, rate limits, and upgrade options for the API key on this connection, or the free-tier allowance and the key URL for an anonymous caller. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: formation.status · Private data: account.status, formation.status, formation.checkout, formation.payment_status · Public sink: formation.checkout, formation.payment_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: formation.status · Private data: account.status, formation.status, formation.checkout, formation.payment_status · Public sink: formation.checkout, formation.payment_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
